title: Dereference of a nullable lookup result
claim: Dereference of a nullable lookup result: available=false reaches p->value with p equal to nullptr.
reasoning_summary: available=false is passed unchanged to review_lookup, whose false branch returns nullptr. The same p is dereferenced on the next statement with no intervening guard or write.
suggestion: Check p immediately after lookup or return a non-null result with a documented invariant.
